hints.title: Segment Partitioning
hints.text: Every element outside the range [minK, maxK] breaks the contiguous subarray condition, acting as a partition barrier.

hints.title: Contiguous Segment Counting
hints.text: Within any valid contiguous segment of length L where all elements are within bounds, the number of valid subarrays is L * (L + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Two Pointer or Length Accumulation
hints.text: Iterate through nums, track the length of the current consecutive valid run, and reset it whenever an out-of-bounds element is encountered.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan with running valid length accumulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) pairs incurs timeout on large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory by accumulating subarrays on the fly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understands that every valid subarray ends at some index i, contributing curr_len ending at i.
